canonical_project: ICS Arabia Desert Dragon Data Center Phase 1 (Al Kharj Industrial City, MODON)
owner: ICS Arabia (Desert Dragon, with China Mobile International and Lumaotong Group)
notes: Phase 1 of the 187 MW national Desert Dragon program is a ~64-65 MW Tier III data center at Al Kharj Industrial City (MODON), Riyadh region; construction started Nov 2024 with first phase expected operational around March 2026. Later phases in Jeddah, Dammam, NEOM (other divisions).
